title: Brown's Asymptotic Limit Functor and Proper Homology
summary: In 1974, E. M. Brown introduced the $\wp$-functor to study the proper homotopy groups of an end, suggesting a parallel proper homology theory that has since remained undeveloped. In this paper, we construct this missing proper homology and relate it to proper homotopy by developing a proper Hurewicz theorem. Bypassing abstract pro-categorical machinery, we show that $\wp$ has major advantages over the classical limits $\varprojlim$ and $\varprojlim^1$: it is exact, detects pro-triviality, satisfies a cardinality dichotomy, and connects to these classical limits through a 4-term exact…
